name: so101_reach_mujoco_v0
description: MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 reach benchmark with fixed target eval cases.
notes: The SO-101 task requires MuJoCo Menagerie robotstudio_so101/so101.xml from AUTORESEARCH_SO101_MJCF, MUJOCO_MENAGERIE_PATH, or .external/mujoco_menagerie and fails closed if the real RobotStudio/Menagerie model is missing.
Reach success mirrors the SO101-Nexus ReachConfig default success_threshold=0.02 m, with targets sampled from a 0.15 m half-extent 3D workspace around the task center.
This first benchmark is a deterministic reach-to-target control surface; grasping/manipulation tasks should be added as separate benchmarks after the reach task is stable.
